sources.entry: SourceBans++ - Admin, ban, and communication management system for games running on the Source engine. (Source Code) CC-BY-SA-4.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: SourceBans++ is a self-hostable web panel for administering bans, admins, and communication on servers running the Source engine.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SourceBans++ as a global admin, ban, and communication management system for the Source engine. The web panel is installed by unzipping a release into a web root and running the browser-based /install/ wizard. The repository includes SourceMod plugins under game/addons/sourcemod/, which the README places under GPLv3. The README points to separate docs for install, upgrade, configuration, and FAQ, plus an ARCHITECTURE.md codebase tour and a Docker-based local dev stack described in AGENTS.md. The README does not list specific ban or moderation features beyond this general description.
use_cases: manage bans across Source engine game servers
run a central admin list for a game community
self-host a game server ban panel
coordinate player communication controls on game servers
administer clan or server network moderation
how_to_run: Download the latest sourcebans-pp-X.Y.Z.webpanel-only.zip from Releases
Unzip the archive into your web root
Visit /install/ in a browser and follow the setup wizard
See the Quickstart guide in the project docs for full install and plugin setup
notable: Separate GPLv3 SourceMod plugins alongside an Elastic License 2.0 web panel
Web-panel-only release zip with browser install wizard
Documented upgrade path across major version boundaries
Vendored LightOpenID and TinyMCE with their own licenses
caveats: Hosting the panel as a managed service for third parties requires a separate commercial license under ELv2
Plugin and web panel have different licenses, so both must be checked for a given use
Maintained on volunteer time, per the README
